name: sparx — Landscaping (Design & Build)
tagline: A lush, portfolio-led template for landscape design & build firms — book consultations online from day one.
description: A premium landscape design-and-build site — a lush cream-and-emerald palette with a warm terracotta accent and a refined serif display, led by finished-project photography. Installs a working booking flow for free consultations and estimates: a real consult menu (design, hardscape, planting, irrigation, outdoor living), three designers you book by name with their own hours, and a design-deposit policy for full engagements. Ships as "Verdant Grounds".
